_doc: PRE-DEFINED MOLECULES (doc/OpenWork.md row MD).  Cartesian positions in BOHR; 'el' is the element
symbol.  These are the finite systems the molecular tests and the GUI's pick-list start from.

H2O.comment: experimental geometry, C2 axis along z

N2.comment: d = 2.07 bohr along x, NOT centred (-1.03 / +1.04): the geometry the M_HF_U/M_DFT anchors were banked at -- keep it verbatim

O2.comment: experimental bond length 1.208 A = 2.282 bohr along z (M_DFT's orientation); the triplet ground state

B.comment: a boron atom: the open-2p1 doublet that flips DIIS to GDM (the tough light-atom test)

CH4.comment: tetrahedral, C-H 2.0504 bohr (1.085 A, the CH4_dzvp box's geometry); Td, the Q2 Hartree-route table (lane S 2026-11-25)

SF6.comment: octahedral, S-F 1.564 A; Oh, the Q2 Hartree-route table's imposed (folded) case (lane S 2026-11-25)

TeF6.comment: octahedral, Te-F 1.82 A: M_DFT's MakeTeF6 and the 2026-11-05 runs' geometry; the Q2 Hartree-route table (lane S 2026-11-25)
